generated.as: consent_status = 'OPTED_IN' AND unsubscribed_at IS NULL AND archived_at IS NULL AND anonymised_at IS NULL

contact_organisation_email_uq.name: contact_organisation_email_uq
contact_organisation_email_uq.where: "contact"."email" IS NOT NULL AND "contact"."archived_at" IS NULL

contact_consent_stated_ck.name: contact_consent_stated_ck
contact_consent_stated_ck.value: "contact"."consent_status" = 'UNKNOWN' OR ("contact"."consent_at" IS NOT NULL AND "contact"."consent_source" IS NOT NULL)

opportunity_won_ck.name: opportunity_won_ck
opportunity_won_ck.value: "opportunity"."stage_kind" <> 'WON' OR ("opportunity"."estimated_value" IS NOT NULL AND "opportunity"."expected_close_date" IS NOT NULL)

organisation_tenant_vat_uq.name: organisation_tenant_vat_uq
organisation_tenant_vat_uq.where: "organisation"."vat_number" IS NOT NULL AND "organisation"."archived_at" IS NULL

task_subject_ck.name: task_subject_ck
task_subject_ck.value: ("task"."subject_type" IS NULL) = ("task"."subject_id" IS NULL) AND ("task"."subject_type" IS NULL OR "task"."subject_type" IN ('organisation', 'opportunity'))

task_subject_company_ck.name: task_subject_company_ck
task_subject_company_ck.value: "task"."subject_type" IS NULL OR "task"."organisation_id" IS NOT NULL

brief_dates_ck.name: brief_dates_ck
brief_dates_ck.value: "brief"."requested_start" IS NULL OR "brief"."requested_end" IS NULL OR "brief"."requested_end" >= "brief"."requested_start"

brief_confirmed_ck.name: brief_confirmed_ck
brief_confirmed_ck.value: "brief"."status" NOT IN ('CONFIRMED', 'CONVERTED') OR "brief"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL

brief_converted_ck.name: brief_converted_ck
brief_converted_ck.value: ("brief"."status" = 'CONVERTED') = ("brief"."converted_campaign_id" IS NOT NULL AND "brief"."converted_at" IS NOT NULL)

brief_line_dates_ck.name: brief_line_dates_ck
brief_line_dates_ck.value: "brief_line"."start_date" IS NULL OR "brief_line"."end_date" IS NULL OR "brief_line"."end_date" >= "brief_line"."start_date"

campaign_location_dates_ck.name: campaign_location_dates_ck
campaign_location_dates_ck.value: "campaign_location"."start_date" IS NULL OR "campaign_location"."end_date" IS NULL OR "campaign_location"."end_date" >= "campaign_location"."start_date"

campaign_location_hold_ck.name: campaign_location_hold_ck
campaign_location_hold_ck.value: ("campaign_location"."status" = 'ON_HOLD') = ("campaign_location"."previous_status" IS NOT NULL) AND ("campaign_location"."previous_status" IS NULL OR "campaign_location"."previous_status" NOT IN ('ON_HOLD', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED'))
